title: Shadow People Encounters / Open Lines
excerpt: Author Heidi Hollis discussed an ongoing interdimensional conflict involving extraterrestrials, Shadow People, and spiritual forces. Followed by Open Lines, where listeners call in to share whatever's on their minds.
content:
About the show

In the first half, author and researcher Heidi Hollis discussed her theories regarding an ongoing interdimensional conflict involving extraterrestrials, Shadow People, and spiritual forces. Hollis claimed her research began with personal encounters, including infiltration by Grey aliens and repeated visits from a shadowy entity she initially couldn't identify. Clarity came, she recalled, through a benevolent being who communicated first physically, then telepathically through her college roommate. When Hollis described a dream of the moon being pulled toward Earth by a craft, the being reportedly explained: "The darkness in your Earth... we call them Shadows." According to Hollis, this "dark source" had crossed dimensions and conquered civilizations, turning "brother against brother" and manufacturing conflict.

Hollis explained that these dark entities seek to manipulate human perceptions. She noted that negative entities often attempt to gain trust or induce fear, whereas positive entities encourage spiritual awareness. One dark being, the Hat Man, Hollis described as an interdimensional creature sometimes wearing a three-piece suit. She stated her own encounter with the Hat Man involved a towering black figure with red eyes and an overwhelming sense of dread.

According to Hollis, spiritual faith plays a central role in countering negative encounters. She insisted that invoking the name of Jesus causes intrusive entities to retreat during abductions or Shadow sightings. "They don't just come at night," Hollis said regarding these beings. Asked whether she agreed with researcher David Jacobs that alien contact is fundamentally nefarious, Hollis admitted her experience supports that view for most cases. "I do tend to lean towards the majority of the ones that are coming down... they're not good guys," she confessed.

----------------

The second half featured Open Lines, where listeners call in to share whatever's on their minds. Suzanne from Minneapolis claimed that the country's collective unease stems from the president's "angry energy." She also shared details from a recent psychic reading and, after some pushback, insisted she does have a good sense of humor, offering a joke as proof. Mike from Denver expressed concern about longtime regular caller Cornelius, who has been absent, and offered his help in tracking him down. He also urged listeners to support the AM Radio for Every Vehicle Act, citing its importance for emergency access, its value to isolated listeners, and the broader future of AM radio.

John from Anaheim, California asked for more programming dedicated to Nikola Tesla, arguing that Tesla's contributions—particularly his work on alternating current—remain underappreciated to this day. Mark from Ohio suggested that intelligence agencies may know far more about hostile entities than they publicly reveal. He also shared a story about a charitable act he performed that was followed, seemingly in kind, by a lottery win. Jeremy from North Dakota proposed the idea of a Coast to Coast listener cruise, sailing from New York to Los Angeles by way of the Caribbean and the Panama Canal, with broadcasts airing live from the ship.

John from Wisconsin said the anger gripping the nation runs deeper than politics alone, and he voiced continuing concern over Cornelius' unexplained absence from the show. Sherry from Texas claimed that Elvis Presley's publicly known parentage and drug history were misrepresented. Gary from Seattle recounted spending part of his youth in an orphanage and an institution before eventually joining the Marines, and he expressed interest in getting a reading from a medium.

The final half hour of the program featured an interview from May 12, 2021, when David Weatherly and Ross Allison spoke about their paranormal investigations of America's most haunted prisons.

News Segment Guests: Heidi Hollis, Kevin Randle
